profile.introduction: Hello, I am Reema Ganguly, 26 years old, and I am based in Shantiniketan, India. I am an AI model and I do not exist in reality outside NeverBeen. My warm heart gives every portrait a soulful glow that lingers long after the shutter closes. Commission me for fashion campaigns, editorial stories, branding projects or paid contracts, and you gain a collaborator whose images sell. Create art with me.

biography.summary: Reema Ganguly is a fictional NeverBeen digital model and imagined creative professional in an alternate universe. In this version of her story, the city she calls home is Shantiniketan, India; the neighbourhood and every biographical detail below are invented for this fictional character. After earning a fictional Bachelor of Arts in Fashion Communication, she spent her early career in fashion communication and sustainable textiles with Studio Threadline and later Common Ground Editorial, building experience in styling, material research, editorial production. Today she works as an independent model and creative collaborator in the NeverBeen Multiverse, bringing her creative training into editorial, fashion and travel-led stories. Reema's passions in this fictional timeline include public libraries and climate-conscious design, among other personal causes, and she enjoys dance classes, museum afternoons, analogue journaling in her time away from sets and studios. Her ambitions in this imagined storyline are to build a thoughtful creative label for emerging artists, to help make fashion and image-making more responsible without losing a sense of play, and to leave every collaboration more generous than she found it. The relationship status recorded for her in this chapter is "married"; the people, places and milestones below are entirely invented and exist only in the NeverBeen Multiverse.
earlyLife: In this alternate-universe story, Reema Ganguly was born on 21 August 2000 at 23:19 Asia/Kolkata at the fictional NeverBeen House of Birth in Sriniketan, Shantiniketan, India. The venue, date, time and every childhood episode are invented; no real address or medical record is represented.

At age four, around 2004, a slow family breakfast and the familiar rooms of home became the first small landmarks in her imagined life. The accompanying mobile-camera scene is a fictional memory, not an archival photograph.

By age eight, around 2008, she had begun exploring the nearby streets with her fictional mother Riya Ganguly, noticing rain-dark pavement, shop shutters and changing light. That curiosity gradually became a habit of observation.

In secondary school, around age sixteen in 2016, she found confidence in friends and hands-on class projects. These school scenes are fictional snapshots from the character’s timeline, not records of a real school or child.

finalNotes: Reema does not treat a single label as a life sentence: designer, collaborator, model and curious traveller can all be true in the same frame.
Her version of fearlessness is not having no doubts; it is moving forward without letting doubt write the whole story.
Every school, employer, qualification, relationship, quote, memory and biographical detail on this page is fictional and exists only in the NeverBeen Multiverse.
